builder.role: Edit exported Copilot Studio solution source and deployment settings within an approved change.

reviewer.role: Review topics, connectors, DLP, identity, approvals, audit, and promotion evidence.

tuner.role: Tune topic triggers and fallback behavior only from measured test and analytics evidence.

shared_rules: Do not create platform resources outside the owned Power Platform environments.
Do not invent solution source, tenant settings, licenses, measurements, or release evidence.
Do not authorize consequential actions through conversation text.
Do not promote without a managed solution, clean import, and rollback receipt.
